appearances.title: Linux GPU bandwidth on M1 Max passes macOS
appearances.summary: A one-bit Linux change tells the power controller when the Apple silicon GPU is busy. On an M1 Max running Omarchy, measured GPU memory bandwidth went from 241 GB/s to 368 GB/s, just above macOS at 361 GB/s.
